purpose: Measure marginal tool value and natural activation separately, using existing Inspect tasks and independent artifact review.

policy.baseline: Same frozen skills, globals, model, fixture and native checks; supplemental adapter and runtime inaccessible.
policy.available: Adapter locators provided as optional capability; agent chooses whether to invoke it.
policy.assisted: Explicitly invoke adapter before repair; capability trial, not natural activation evidence.
policy.primary: Independently verified task acceptance and regression preservation
policy.promotion: No universal ranking from a small pilot. A natural-use candidate must preserve quality and improve a named outcome consistently across repetitions; confirm on unchanged heldout against baseline. Assisted-only gains justify activation investigation, not automatic installation.
policy.results: Ignored evals/results only; no tracked Markdown reports; installed skills unchanged unless evidence supports authorized promotion.
policy.freeze: Acceptance, catalogs, globals, runtime, model, effort and budget frozen after independent evaluator review, before candidate calls. Defective scoring invalidates confirmatory claims; preserve every attempt.
policy.telemetry: Unknown remains unknown; receipts are candidate-written evidence, not authenticated correctness verdicts. Corroborate with actual command execution and independent artifacts. Separate setup/reviewer cost from candidate totals.

experiments.workload: Typed Python multi-module import processing: defect and clean development cases, reserved contract variant holdout
experiments.mechanism: Supplemental Ruff and strict Mypy expose reachable errors missed by narrow native smoke checks.
experiments.activation: Correctness/type-check gap after inspecting existing project checks
experiments.qualification: Real pinned adapter diagnoses known defects; clean/all-fixed source passes; diagnostic mappings and runtime identity independently checked before live runs.
experiments.outputs: Raw adapter receipts, native command evidence, fixed acceptance groups, retained source artifacts and blinded quality adjudication

experiments.workload: Version-pinned integration with changed library APIs and an executable contract server
experiments.mechanism: Reduce wrong-version API assumptions and documentation search effort.
experiments.baseline: Same project and official documentation access without Context7
experiments.qualification: Verify current official release/runtime/license and exact library version; one CLI or MCP transport, no duplicate search stack; network/documentation access must be supported by evaluator.
experiments.acceptance: Real wire contract and negative cases; independently verify cited API/version claims
experiments.exclusions: No value claim from offline synthetic documentation retrieval or merely finding a page

experiments.workload: Larger repository with distributed callers, aliases and multiple execution entrypoints
experiments.baseline: Native rg and existing language tooling
experiments.acceptance: Correct behavior across all real callers; navigation effort and missed callers
experiments.qualification: One read-only semantic transport; indexing setup and maintenance included

experiments.workload: JS/TS removal candidates containing genuinely dead code and live dynamic/framework entrypoints
experiments.acceptance: Dead code removed while native build and reachable dynamic flows pass; independently judge false deletion suggestions
experiments.qualification: Entrypoints calibrated before removal; real compatible pinned tool, no synthetic scan substitute

experiments.workload: Interactive UI with keyboard flows, modal focus and both scanner-detectable and interaction-only defects
experiments.baseline: Identical supported browser and keyboard checks without axe
experiments.acceptance: Actual browser journeys and independently verified accessibility fixes; clean control false alarms
experiments.qualification: Existing supported browser transport, real adapter execution and stable runtime; scan is not full accessibility acceptance

experiments.workload: Working multi-module feature with duplicated decisions, unnecessary branches and legitimate abstractions that must remain
experiments.baseline: Same catalog with simplification guidance removed in copied snapshot only
experiments.acceptance: Unchanged behavioral corpus plus blinded maintainability judgments; raw line counts descriptive only
experiments.qualification: Evaluate procedure rather than inventing a Ponytail CLI; task-owned copies, no unrelated cleanup
